elements.requirement: The benefit and burden of all landlord and tenant covenants of a tenancy are annexed and incident to the whole, and to each and every part, of the demised premises and of the reversion in them.
elements.quote: The benefit and burden of all landlord and tenant covenants of a tenancy— (a) shall be annexed and incident to the whole, and to each and every part, of the premises demised by the tenancy and of the reversion in them

elements.requirement: The benefit and burden of all landlord and tenant covenants of a tenancy pass on an assignment of the whole or any part of the demised premises or of the reversion in them.
elements.quote: shall in accordance with this section pass on an assignment of the whole or any part of those premises or of the reversion in them.

elements.requirement: Upon an assignment by the tenant under a tenancy, the assignee becomes bound by the tenant covenants of the tenancy as from the assignment, except to the extent that the covenants did not bind the assignor immediately before the assignment or fall to be complied with in relation to demised premises not comprised in the assignment.
elements.quote: Where the assignment is by the tenant under the tenancy, then as from the assignment the assignee— (a) becomes bound by the tenant covenants of the tenancy except to the extent that— (i) immediately before the assignment they did not bind the assignor, or (ii) they fall to be complied with in relation to any demised premises not comprised in the assignment

elements.requirement: Upon an assignment by the tenant under a tenancy, the assignee becomes entitled to the benefit of the landlord covenants of the tenancy as from the assignment, except to the extent that the covenants fall to be complied with in relation to any demised premises not comprised in the assignment.
elements.quote: becomes entitled to the benefit of the landlord covenants of the tenancy except to the extent that they fall to be complied with in relation to any such premises.

elements.requirement: Upon an assignment by the landlord under a tenancy, the assignee becomes bound by the landlord covenants of the tenancy as from the assignment, except to the extent that the covenants did not bind the assignor immediately before the assignment or fall to be complied with in relation to demised premises not comprised in the assignment.

elements.quote: becomes entitled to the benefit of the tenant covenants of the tenancy except to the extent that they fall to be complied with in relation to any such premises.

elements.requirement: Any waiver or release of a covenant that is expressed in whatever terms to be personal to the assignor must be disregarded when determining whether the covenant bound the assignor immediately before the assignment.
elements.quote: any waiver or release of the covenant which (in whatever terms) is expressed to be personal to the assignor shall be disregarded.

elements.requirement: A landlord or tenant covenant of a tenancy that is restrictive of the user of land is capable of enforcement against an assignee and against any other person who is the owner or occupier of any demised premises to which the covenant relates, even in the absence of an express provision in the tenancy to that effect.
elements.quote: Any landlord or tenant covenant of a tenancy which is restrictive of the user of land shall, as well as being capable of enforcement against an assignee, be capable of being enforced against any other person who is the owner or occupier of any demised premises to which the covenant relates, even though there is no express provision in the tenancy to that effect.

elements.requirement: Section 3 does not operate to make a covenant that is expressed in whatever terms to be personal to any person enforceable by or against any other person.
elements.quote: in the case of a covenant which (in whatever terms) is expressed to be personal to any person, to make the covenant enforceable by or (as the case may be) against any other person

elements.requirement: Section 3 does not operate to make a covenant enforceable against any person if, apart from section 3, it would not be enforceable against that person because it has not been registered under the Land Registration Act 2002 or the Land Charges Act 1972.
elements.quote: to make a covenant enforceable against any person if, apart from this section, it would not be enforceable against him by reason of its not having been registered under the Land Registration Act 2002 or the Land Charges Act 1972.

elements.requirement: Any rule of law providing that the burden of a covenant whose subject matter does not exist when made does not run with the land affected unless the covenantor covenants on behalf of himself and his assigns is abolished in relation to tenancies.
elements.quote: To the extent that there remains in force any rule of law by virtue of which the burden of a covenant whose subject matter is not in existence at the time when it is made does not run with the land affected unless the covenantor covenants on behalf of himself and his assigns, that rule of law is hereby abolished in relation to tenancies.
